title: Many Jobs, One Owner
description: A busy dispatcher who fires off five different report requests in one sitting expects to find all five later, each intact and correctly attributed — not merged, not missing, not attributed to the wrong desk.
successCondition: As one dispatcher, POST /api/reporting/jobs five times with five distinct from/to ranges. Querying report_jobs via `npm run db:psql` with `select id, requested_by_id, from_date, to_date from report_jobs where requested_by_id = '<dispatcher id>' order by created_at desc limit 5` confirms exactly 5 rows exist matching your 5 requests, each with the correct from_date/to_date pairing (no two swapped), and every single one has requested_by_id equal to that one dispatcher's id. Poll all 5 to ready and confirm GET /api/reporting/jobs/:id for each returns 200 for that dispatcher specifically (not just admin).
hints: There's no GET /api/reporting/jobs list-all endpoint (per docs/api/reporting.md) — polling GET /jobs/:id individually by the 5 ids you captured from the 5 POST responses is the only way to check each one via the API.
Give each of the 5 ranges a visibly distinct span (different months) so mismatched from_date/to_date pairs are easy to catch by eye when you query the DB.
